title: Chintamani Library v2.6.0 — Student Photo Upload, Real-Time Notifications & Smart In-App Updates
releaseNotes: REMOVED: Live selfie camera requirement completely removed from admission flow
FEATURE: New student photo upload (device storage, gallery, up to 5MB, strict branch-isolated Cloudinary storage)
FIX: Eliminated false low-memory errors permanently with zero-copy stream uploads
FEATURE: Real notification tracking & deduplication — no repeated old alerts on app launch
FEATURE: Notification tap routing — tapping an alert opens the exact screen and branch
FEATURE: Centralized In-App Auto-Updater with semantic versioning
